description: Verifies timelike geodesics in horizon-regular Kerr-Schild coordinates: an orbit crossing the polar axis stays finite for two thousand adaptive steps, and a radial infall crosses the outer horizon without the integration failing.

checks.label: the timelike normalization admits a real temporal velocity near the axis
every adaptive step of the polar trajectory succeeds
the Cartesian coordinates stay finite while the orbit crosses the polar axis
the timelike normalization admits a real temporal velocity for the radial infall
every adaptive step of the infall succeeds
the infalling particle crosses the outer horizon in Kerr-Schild coordinates
